scalars.scalar_value: A bachelor’s degree in arts or sciences or any combination of education and experience that provides the required knowledge, skills, and abilities is required.

items.item_text: A valid driver’s license and the ability to be insured under the College’s authorized driver’s policy are required to drive college-owned vehicles.
A bachelor’s degree in arts or sciences or any combination of education and experience that provides the required knowledge, skills, and abilities is required.
Three to five years relevant professional administrative and clerical experience is required. Experience within a higher education environment is preferred.
Schedule and coordinate meetings, appointments, and travel arrangements for IT staff.
Prepare and distribute agendas and meeting materials, and take minutes at meetings as required.
Maintain department filing systems and records, both electronic and paper-based.
Order and maintain office supplies and equipment for the IT department.
Assist with the preparation of reports and presentations.
Manage department calendars and schedules.
Coordinate and provide administrative support for technical events.
Assist with department projects and initiatives as required.
Answer phone and email inquiries and respond to routine requests for information.
Perform other duties as assigned.
Take and follow directions.
Work cooperatively with others.
Receive and respond appropriately to constructive criticism.
Display a positive attitude.
Balance multiple tasks and priorities
Perform other essential duties and tasks specific to the position.
Excellent organizational, time management, and communication skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel and Word), Adobe Acrobat Pro, and Box.com. Familiarity with Workday Financials, Qualtrics, and Lucid Chart is a plus.

Experience and demonstrated ability to work independently on assigned tasks, effectively utilizing existing reference materials and resources, accurately forecasting task completion times, and prioritizing tasks.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Familiarity with office equipment, such as printers, copiers, and scanners.
Attention to detail and the ability to maintain confidentiality.
